A small gear that meshes with a larger gear or a toothed rack.
A plain sleeve fitted between moving parts, such as a shaft and its housing, to provide a sliding bearing surface.
A rotating machine shaft that supports and turns a cutting tool or workpiece.
A groove in a shaft or hub that receives a fitted key to transmit rotation between the parts.
A rotating shaft with shaped lobes that move followers, often to operate engine valves.
A shaft with offset crankpins that works with connecting rods to convert between reciprocating and rotary motion.
A rigid link that connects a piston to a crankpin and transmits force between them.
A rotating wheel that stores kinetic energy and helps smooth changes in rotational speed.
A small sealed glass container that holds a medical liquid until its neck is opened.

senses.fa: ویال؛ ظرفِ کوچکِ دارو با درپوش
senses.en: A small medical container, often with a rubber stopper and protective cap, for holding a liquid or powder.
A sweet, usually thick liquid form of medicine.
A small solid medicine form made to dissolve slowly in the mouth.
A solid medicine form with a base that softens or dissolves within a body cavity.
A compartmented container that keeps tablets or capsules separated for an agreed medicine schedule.
A flat blunt instrument used to hold the tongue down during an examination of the mouth or throat.
A small electronic device worn in or behind the ear that amplifies sound for a person with hearing loss.
A covering worn over one eye in a medical or protective context.
A small protective object made to fit in the outer ear canal, commonly to reduce unwanted sound.
A thin thread or tape used to remove plaque and food particles from between teeth.
A removable dental appliance with artificial teeth that replaces some or all teeth in an upper or lower arch.
A valve that controls a passage by turning a ball with a hole through it.
A valve that opens or closes a passage by moving a gate across the flow path.
A valve with a disc that turns on a shaft across a pipe passage to control flow.
A valve that allows forward flow and closes automatically to resist flow in the reverse direction.
A device that reduces a fluid supply pressure and controls the downstream pressure.
An instrument that indicates the pressure of a gas or liquid.
An instrument that measures how much fluid passes a point per unit of time.
A flowmeter in which a float rises within an upright tapered tube as flow increases.
A lifting device that uses pressurized liquid to move a ram or piston.
An actuator in which pressurized liquid moves a piston to produce straight-line motion.
A device that stores hydraulic energy by holding liquid under pressure for later use.
An actuator that uses compressed air to produce mechanical motion, here the straight-line movement of a piston rod.
An external device that supports, aligns or assists an existing part of the body.
A fabric support that holds the forearm against the front of the body.

senses.fa: بوتِ پزشکیِ حمایتیِ پا و مچ
senses.en: A removable medical boot with a rigid base and supports around the foot and ankle.
An elastic medical leg garment designed to apply pressure to the leg.
An external support worn around the ankle joint to support it or limit selected movements.
An external support fitted around the knee to support the joint or limit selected movements.
An external support that steadies the wrist or limits selected wrist movements.
A support around the neck that limits selected movement of the head and neck.
An elastic strip or loop that provides resistance when stretched during exercise or rehabilitation.
A platform with an unstable support underneath, used for balance practice.
Two parallel handrails used to provide hand support during rehabilitation activities.
An instrument used to measure joint angles or a joint's range of motion.
A heat exchanger that transfers warmth from hot water or steam into the surrounding room.
Equipment that heats water to supply hot water or steam for heating or a process.

senses.fa: کورهٔ گرم‌کنِ هوا؛ دستگاهِ گرمایشِ هوای اجباری
senses.en: A building-heating unit that heats air and sends it through ducts to rooms.
A machine with rotating blades that moves air, here an axial type with airflow along its shaft.
A machine that drives a stream of air, here a centrifugal type with an impeller inside a scroll-shaped casing.
A controller that responds to temperature and switches or adjusts heating or cooling to maintain a chosen temperature.
A temperature sensor made from two different metal conductors joined at a sensing junction.
A resistor whose resistance changes strongly with temperature, used for sensing or control.
A strip of two bonded metal layers with different thermal expansion, causing it to bend as temperature changes.

senses.fa: عایقِ حرارتی؛ مادهٔ کاهش‌دهندهٔ انتقالِ گرما
senses.en: Material used to reduce heat transfer between objects or spaces.
A flexible connection that accommodates movement between connected parts, here a metal bellows in a pipe system.
Equipment that removes heat from circulating water by contact with air, often using evaporation of some of the water.
The largest brain region, formed by two cerebral hemispheres and involved in thought, sensation and voluntary movement.
The lower rear brain region that helps coordinate movement and balance.
The brain region formed by the midbrain, pons and medulla, connecting higher brain regions with the spinal cord.
The cord of nervous tissue within the vertebral canal that carries signals and helps organise reflexes.
A single bone of the vertebral column, typically with a body and an arch around a central opening.
A pad with a fibrous outer ring and a softer centre between adjacent vertebral bodies.
A curved fibrocartilage pad between the femur and tibia in the knee.
The strong tendon joining the calf muscles to the back of the heel bone.
A nerve cell specialised for receiving and transmitting signals.
A junction where a neuron passes a signal to another cell.
A haemoglobin-containing blood cell that carries oxygen; mature human examples are biconcave and lack a nucleus.
A nucleated blood cell belonging to the body's immune defence system.
An iron-based alloy containing carbon and often other elements, used to make structural and machine parts.
A lightweight silvery metallic element used, often in alloys, to make many engineering products.
A reddish metallic element widely used to conduct electricity or heat and to make tubing.
A family of alloys in which copper and zinc are the main metals.
A copper-based alloy, traditionally one in which tin is the main added element.
Steel containing enough chromium to form a protective surface layer that resists corrosion.

senses.fa: چدن؛ آلیاژِ ریختگیِ آهن و کربن
senses.en: An iron-carbon alloy generally containing more carbon than steel and commonly shaped by casting.

senses.fa: آلیاژ؛ مادهٔ فلزیِ حاصل از ترکیبِ عناصر
senses.en: A metallic material made by combining a metal with one or more other elements.
A material made from two or more distinct constituent materials that retain their identities within the combined structure.
An inorganic nonmetallic material, often shaped and consolidated using heat.
A substance composed of very large molecules built from repeating structural units.
A panel made by bonding thin wood veneers in layers, usually with neighbouring grain directions at right angles.

senses.fa: دهلیز؛ حفرهٔ بالاییِ دریافت‌کنندهٔ خون در قلب
senses.en: Either of the two upper heart chambers that receive blood before it passes into a ventricle.
Either of the two lower heart chambers that pump blood into the pulmonary artery or the aorta.
The main artery carrying blood from the left ventricle into the systemic circulation.

senses.fa: بزرگ‌سیاهرگ؛ هر یک از دو سیاهرگِ اصلیِ ورودی به دهلیزِ راست
senses.en: Either of the two large veins returning systemic blood to the right atrium of the heart.

senses.fa: مویرگ؛ رگِ خونیِ بسیار ریز با دیوارهٔ نازک
senses.en: A microscopic thin-walled blood vessel in which substances can pass between blood and surrounding tissue.

senses.fa: دریچهٔ قلب؛ ساختارِ هدایت‌کنندهٔ جریانِ یک‌طرفه
senses.en: A structure with movable leaflets or cusps that helps blood flow in one direction through the heart.

senses.fa: پلاکت؛ قطعهٔ سلولیِ کوچکِ دخیل در بندآمدنِ خون
senses.en: A small nucleus-free cell fragment in human blood that helps form a platelet plug and supports blood clotting.
The liquid part of blood, containing water, dissolved substances and proteins including clotting factors.

senses.fa: هموگلوبین؛ پروتئینِ متصل‌شونده به اکسیژن در گلبولِ قرمز
senses.en: The iron-containing protein in red blood cells that binds oxygen and helps transport it around the body.

senses.fa: نبض؛ اتساعِ ضربانیِ سرخرگ بر اثرِ ضربانِ قلب
senses.en: The rhythmic expansion of an artery associated with pressure waves produced by the heartbeat.

senses.fa: گردشِ خون؛ حرکتِ پیوستهٔ خون در قلب و رگ‌ها
senses.en: The continuous movement of blood through the heart and blood vessels, including the pulmonary and systemic circuits.

senses.fa: تنفس؛ نفس‌کشیدن و تبادلِ گازهای تنفسی
senses.en: The processes of breathing and exchanging oxygen and carbon dioxide between the air and the blood.

senses.fa: یک‌سوساز؛ مدارِ تبدیلِ جریانِ متناوب به یک‌سویه
senses.en: An electronic device or circuit that converts alternating current into current flowing in one direction.

senses.fa: اینورتر؛ مبدلِ توانِ جریانِ مستقیم به متناوب
senses.en: An electronic power converter that changes direct-current electrical power into alternating-current electrical power.
An electronic circuit that uses supplied energy to generate a signal that repeats periodically.
An electronic device or circuit that uses energy from a power supply to increase the amplitude of an input signal.
An electronic circuit whose components and interconnections are formed together on a small piece of semiconductor material.
An integrated circuit that combines a processor, memory and peripherals to control functions in an embedded system.
A reusable board with internally connected contacts for building and testing temporary electronic circuits without soldering.
A short insulated wire with connector ends used to make temporary electrical connections between circuit points.
An electronic circuit that produces a logical output according to a Boolean rule applied to its logical inputs.
A high-gain electronic amplifier that responds to the voltage difference between its non-inverting and inverting inputs.
A device that transfers a signal by light between electrically isolated input and output sides.
An electronic device or circuit that controls an output voltage near a set value while operating within specified limits.

senses.fa: سرفه؛ بیرون‌راندنِ ناگهانی و پرفشارِ هوا از راه‌های هوایی
senses.en: A sudden forceful expulsion of air from the airways, usually with a characteristic sound.

senses.fa: عطسه؛ خروجِ ناگهانی و غیرارادیِ هوا از بینی و دهان
senses.en: A sudden involuntary burst of air through the nose and mouth.

senses.fa: تب؛ افزایشِ دمای بدن نسبت به محدودهٔ معمول
senses.en: A rise in body temperature above its usual range, occurring as a sign of an underlying process.
Pain felt in the head, which may vary in location, character and duration.

senses.fa: سرگیجه؛ احساسِ سبکیِ سر یا بی‌تعادلی
senses.en: A feeling of lightheadedness, unsteadiness or disturbed balance.
An unpleasant feeling of being sick to the stomach, often with an urge to vomit.

senses.fa: خستگی؛ احساسِ کمبودِ انرژی و فرسودگی
senses.en: A feeling of tiredness, weariness or lack of energy that can limit ordinary activities.

senses.fa: خارش؛ احساسِ پوستیِ برانگیزانندهٔ میل به خاراندن
senses.en: An irritating skin sensation that creates an urge to scratch.
An unpleasant bodily feeling that may be described as sharp, dull, burning or aching.

senses.fa: لرزش؛ حرکتِ ریتمیک و غیرارادیِ بخشی از بدن
senses.en: An involuntary rhythmic shaking movement of a part of the body.

senses.fa: خشکی یا سفتیِ حرکتی؛ دشواری در حرکت‌دادنِ مفصل یا ناحیهٔ بدن
senses.en: A feeling of reduced ease of movement in a joint or body region.

senses.fa: تنگیِ نفس؛ احساسِ دشواری یا ناراحتی در تنفس
senses.en: A subjective feeling that breathing is difficult, uncomfortable or requires unusual effort.
A device that uses supplied energy to produce controlled mechanical movement in a machine or system.
A sensing device that converts mechanical position or movement into an electrical signal.
A mechanically operated switch that changes its electrical state when a moving part physically contacts its operating mechanism.

senses.fa: حسگرِ مجاورتی؛ حسگرِ حضورِ نزدیکِ بدونِ تماس
senses.en: A sensor that detects a nearby object without physically touching it.

senses.fa: حسگرِ فوتوالکتریک؛ حسگرِ نوریِ تشخیصِ جسم
senses.en: A sensor that detects an object or change by sensing light that is interrupted or reflected.
A motor used with feedback control to regulate its position, speed or another motion variable.
An electric motor designed to rotate through a sequence of discrete angular steps in response to control pulses.
An industrial electronic controller that reads inputs, executes a stored control program and updates outputs to control machines or processes.
A physical assembly of controls and indicators used to operate or monitor a machine or process.

senses.fa: بازخورد؛ بازگشتِ اطلاعاتِ خروجی به کنترل‌کننده
senses.en: Information about a system output that is returned to a controller and used to adjust the system.
The desired reference value of a variable that a control system aims to maintain or reach.

senses.fa: کنترلِ توقفِ اضطراری؛ شستیِ توقفِ اضطراری
senses.en: A machine control intended to initiate an emergency stopping function when an urgent hazard requires it.

senses.fa: مچِ دست؛ ناحیهٔ اتصالِ دست و ساعد
senses.en: The region where the hand joins the forearm, including the wrist joints and nearby tissues.

senses.fa: مچِ پا؛ ناحیهٔ اتصالِ ساق و پا
senses.en: The region where the lower leg joins the foot, around the ankle joint.

senses.fa: زانو؛ ناحیهٔ مفصلِ میانِ ران و ساق
senses.en: The joint region between the thigh and lower leg, including the front covered by the kneecap.

senses.fa: شانه؛ ناحیهٔ اتصالِ بازو به تنه
senses.en: The body region where the upper arm joins the trunk, around the shoulder joint.

senses.fa: ناحیهٔ مفصلِ ران؛ محلِ اتصالِ ران به لگن
senses.en: The region around the joint where the upper end of the thigh bone meets the pelvis.

senses.fa: پاشنهٔ پا؛ بخشِ عقبی و زیرینِ پا
senses.en: The rounded back part of the human foot, including the rear part of the sole.

senses.fa: کفِ دست؛ سطحِ داخلیِ دست میانِ مچ و پایهٔ انگشت‌ها
senses.en: The inner surface of the hand between the wrist and the bases of the fingers.
The short first digit of the hand, positioned apart from the four fingers and able to move across the palm.

senses.fa: ناخنِ دست؛ صفحهٔ کراتینیِ روی انتهای انگشتِ دست
senses.en: The hard keratin plate on the back of the tip of a finger or thumb.

senses.fa: ساعد؛ بخشِ اندامِ بالایی میانِ آرنج و مچِ دست
senses.en: The part of the upper limb between the elbow and the wrist.

senses.fa: پشتِ ساق؛ بخشِ عضلانیِ عقبیِ ساقِ پا
senses.en: The rounded muscular back part of the lower leg, below the knee and above the ankle.

senses.fa: انگشتِ پا؛ هر یک از انگشت‌های انتهای پا
senses.en: Any of the five digits at the front end of a typical human foot.
A stationary drilling machine that guides a rotating drill vertically toward a workpiece supported on a table.
A wheel containing abrasive material that removes material from a surface as it rotates against it.
A tool with one or more cutting edges that remove material from a workpiece during machining.
A machine component that holds and positions a cutting tool securely relative to the machine.

senses.fa: قطعهٔ کار؛ ماده یا قطعهٔ در حالِ ساخت
senses.en: The material or part being shaped or otherwise processed in a manufacturing operation.

senses.fa: سه‌نظام؛ نگه‌دارندهٔ فک‌دارِ ابزار یا قطعه
senses.en: A clamping device with jaws that grip a tool or workpiece around its axis.

senses.fa: کولت؛ غلافِ شکاف‌دارِ گیرندهٔ ابزار یا قطعه
senses.en: A slotted clamping sleeve that contracts around a tool shank or workpiece when pressed into a matching seat.

senses.fa: مجموعهٔ مرغکِ تراش؛ تکیه‌گاهِ انتهایِ قطعه
senses.en: An adjustable lathe assembly opposite the headstock that can support the free end of a workpiece with a centre.
A bar carrying a cutting edge for machining the inside surface of an existing hole.
A hand-held welding tool that directs heat-producing energy and, in some processes, shielding gas to the joint.
A hand tool with a heated tip that transfers heat to melt solder and join parts.
A stationary motor-driven grinding machine mounted on a bench and used with abrasive wheels to shape or sharpen parts.

senses.fa: روکشِ دندان؛ پوششِ ترمیمیِ روی دندان
senses.en: An artificial cap that covers a tooth to restore its outer shape and function.

senses.fa: بریجِ دندانی؛ پروتزِ ثابتِ جایگزینِ دندان
senses.en: A fixed dental replacement in which one or more artificial teeth span a gap and are supported by neighbouring teeth or implants.

senses.fa: ایمپلنتِ دندانی؛ پایهٔ کاشتنی در استخوانِ فک
senses.en: A device placed in the jawbone to support an artificial tooth or another dental replacement.

senses.fa: براکتِ ارتودنسی؛ اتصالِ کوچکِ روی دندان
senses.en: A small attachment fixed to a tooth that holds an archwire as part of fixed braces.

senses.fa: قوسِ دندانی؛ ردیفِ خمیدهٔ دندان‌های یک فک
senses.en: The curved row formed by the teeth in one upper or lower jaw.

senses.fa: قالبِ منفیِ دندانی؛ اثرِ فرورفتهٔ دندان‌ها
senses.en: A physical negative imprint of teeth and nearby oral tissues in a material used to record their shape.

senses.fa: تریِ قالب‌گیریِ دندانی؛ نگهدارندهٔ مادهٔ قالب‌گیری
senses.en: A shaped holder that supports dental impression material around a row of teeth.
A powered dental handpiece that turns a small bur for cutting or shaping tooth material and dental restorations.

senses.fa: جرم‌گیرِ دندانی؛ ابزارِ برداشتنِ رسوبِ سختِ دندان
senses.en: A dental instrument used to remove hard deposits from tooth surfaces.
A small dental suction tube that draws saliva and other small amounts of fluid from the mouth.

senses.fa: محافظِ دهان؛ پوششِ محافظِ دندان‌ها در ورزش
senses.en: A resilient protective appliance worn over the teeth during sport to help cushion impacts to the mouth.

senses.fa: نگهدارندهٔ ارتودنسی؛ وسیلهٔ حفظِ موقعیتِ دندان‌ها
senses.en: An orthodontic appliance that helps maintain the position of teeth after they have been moved.
A wedge-shaped stone fitted between the other stones at the highest point of a masonry arch.
A support that projects from a wall and helps it resist sideways forces.
A vertical support that carries a bridge between its end supports.

senses.fa: پیِ پهنِ زیرِ ستون یا دیوار
senses.en: A widened base below a column or wall that spreads its load onto the supporting ground.
A broad, relatively thin structural plate used in a floor, roof or similar part of a structure.
The load-carrying platform of a bridge on which its roadway or walkway is formed.
A low protective wall along the edge of a roof, bridge or balcony.
A passage built through an embankment to carry water beneath a road or railway.
A moulding system used to contain and shape fresh concrete while it hardens.

senses.fa: شبکهٔ فولادیِ مسلح‌کنندهٔ بتن؛ مشِ فولادی
senses.en: A grid of connected steel wires or bars used as reinforcement within concrete.

senses.fa: ورقِ اتصالِ اعضای سازه؛ ورقِ گاست
senses.en: A plate that joins structural members at a connection, such as the meeting point of truss members.
A bolt fixed into concrete or masonry to secure another component to it.
A shallow, usually round laboratory dish with a separate lid, often used to hold material for observing or growing cells and microorganisms.

senses.fa: لامِ میکروسکوپ؛ صفحهٔ شیشه‌ایِ نگهدارندهٔ نمونه
senses.en: A small flat plate, usually of glass, that supports a specimen for viewing under a microscope.

senses.fa: لامِل؛ پوششِ شیشه‌ایِ نازکِ روی نمونهٔ میکروسکوپی
senses.en: A very thin transparent piece of glass or similar material placed over a specimen on a microscope slide.
A laboratory stand with spaces that hold test tubes upright.

senses.fa: کووِت؛ ظرفِ نمونه برای اندازه‌گیریِ نوری
senses.en: A small sample container with transparent optical surfaces through which light passes during a laboratory measurement.

senses.fa: کیسهٔ نمونه؛ پوششِ حملِ ظرفِ نمونهٔ آزمایشگاهی
senses.en: A bag used to contain a laboratory specimen container during handling or transport.

senses.fa: لانست؛ ابزارِ کوچکِ سوراخ‌کردنِ پوست برای نمونهٔ خون
senses.en: A small sharp device used to make a skin puncture when collecting a small blood sample.

senses.fa: لولهٔ جمع‌آوریِ خون؛ ظرفِ لوله‌ایِ نمونهٔ خون
senses.en: A tube designed to receive and contain a blood specimen for laboratory analysis.

senses.fa: لولهٔ سانتریفیوژ؛ ظرفِ نمونهٔ طراحی‌شده برای چرخاندن در سانتریفیوژ
senses.en: A sample tube designed to hold material while it is spun in a centrifuge.

senses.fa: لولهٔ مویین؛ لولهٔ بسیار باریکِ آزمایشگاهی
senses.en: A very narrow laboratory tube used to hold small amounts of liquid, including small blood specimens.

senses.fa: لوپِ کشت؛ ابزارِ حلقه‌دارِ انتقالِ نمونهٔ میکروبی
senses.en: A laboratory tool with a small loop at its end for transferring small amounts of material in microbiology.
A detachable hollow tip fitted to a laboratory pipette to take up and dispense liquid.
A short auxiliary scale read alongside a main scale to resolve a fraction of one main division.
An instrument that shows small movements of a contact tip as movement of a pointer on a dial.
A precision block used as a length reference between two flat, parallel measuring faces.

senses.fa: صفحهٔ صافیِ مرجع؛ صفحهٔ مرجعِ اندازه‌گیری
senses.en: A very flat plate used as a reference surface for checking dimensions and geometry.
A bar with a precisely straight working edge used to check or guide straightness.
A pointed weight suspended from a line to provide a vertical reference under gravity.
A sensor that detects small stretching or compression in a material, often through a change in electrical resistance.
A transducer that converts applied force into a measurable signal.
An instrument that measures a change in the distance between two points on a test specimen.
The turning effect of a force about an axis.
The permitted variation in a specified dimension.
A space deliberately left between two parts, often to allow fitting or movement.

senses.fa: باکتری؛ جاندارِ تک‌سلولیِ بدونِ هستهٔ غشادار
senses.en: A single-celled organism whose genetic material is not enclosed in a membrane-bound nucleus.

senses.fa: ویروس؛ عاملِ عفونیِ وابسته به سلولِ میزبان
senses.en: An infectious agent containing genetic material in a protein coat that makes copies of itself using a host cell.

senses.fa: قارچ؛ جانداری از گروهِ مخمرها، کپک‌ها و قارچ‌های کلاهک‌دار
senses.en: An organism belonging to the group that includes yeasts, moulds and mushrooms, whose cells contain nuclei.
A protein made by immune cells that binds to a particular antigen or part of an antigen.

senses.fa: آنتی‌ژن؛ ماده یا ساختارِ شناسایی‌شونده توسطِ دستگاهِ ایمنی
senses.en: A substance or molecular feature that can be specifically recognized by antibodies or immune-cell receptors.

senses.fa: واکسن؛ فرآوردهٔ ایجادِ شناساییِ ایمنیِ اختصاصی
senses.en: A preparation designed to stimulate immune recognition of a particular disease-causing agent or its antigens.

senses.fa: آلرژی؛ واکنشِ ایمنی به ماده‌ای معمولاً بی‌ضرر
senses.en: An immune reaction to a substance that is usually harmless to most people.
A substance that can trigger an allergic immune reaction in a person who is sensitive to it.
An organism that lives on or in a host and obtains resources at the host’s expense.

senses.fa: گرهٔ لنفاوی؛ ساختارِ ایمنی در مسیرِ لنف
senses.en: A small immune-system organ along lymphatic vessels that filters lymph and contains immune cells.

senses.fa: لوزه؛ تودهٔ بافتِ لنفاوی در حلق
senses.en: A mass of lymphoid tissue near the throat that forms part of the immune system.

senses.fa: مغزِ استخوان؛ بافتِ نرمِ درونِ استخوان
senses.en: Soft tissue within the spaces inside bones, including red marrow that produces blood cells and yellow marrow rich in fat.
A device in which liquid absorbs heat and changes into vapor.
A device in which vapor releases heat and changes into liquid.
A valve that meters refrigerant toward an evaporator while reducing its pressure.
An automatic device that discharges condensate from a steam system while limiting the escape of live steam.
A component that produces heat through electrical resistance.
A space in an engine or burner where fuel burns and releases heat.
A device that delivers a controlled amount of fuel through a nozzle.

senses.fa: منیفولدِ دود؛ چندراههٔ خروجِ گازهای موتور
senses.en: A set of connected passages that collects exhaust gas from several engine cylinders.

senses.fa: لولهٔ اگزوز؛ لولهٔ خروجِ گازهای موتور
senses.en: A pipe that carries exhaust gas away from an engine.
A device that uses supplied energy to transfer heat from a cooler place to a warmer place.
A sealed heat-transfer device in which a working fluid evaporates at a warmer region and condenses at a cooler region.
A projecting surface added to increase the area available for heat transfer.

senses.fa: بیمارِ سرپایی؛ دریافت‌کنندهٔ مراقبت بدونِ بستری‌شدن
senses.en: A patient who receives care at a clinic or hospital without being admitted for a hospital stay.

senses.fa: بیمارِ بستری؛ بیمارِ پذیرفته‌شده برای اقامتِ بیمارستانی
senses.en: A patient admitted to a hospital to receive care during a hospital stay.

senses.fa: ارجاعِ پزشکی؛ فرستادنِ درخواستِ مراقبت به خدمت یا متخصصی دیگر
senses.en: A request or arrangement directing a patient to another health professional or service for assessment or care.

senses.fa: نوبتِ مراجعه؛ زمانِ تعیین‌شده برای دیدارِ درمانی
senses.en: An arranged time for a patient to meet a health professional or attend a healthcare service.

senses.fa: رضایتِ آگاهانه و داوطلبانه برای مراقبتِ پزشکی
senses.en: A person’s informed and voluntary agreement to a proposed examination, treatment or other care.

senses.fa: ترخیص؛ پایان‌دادن به اقامتِ بیمارستانی و هماهنگیِ خروج
senses.en: The process of ending a patient’s hospital stay and arranging their departure or transfer.

senses.fa: پذیرشِ بستری؛ آغازِ اقامت به‌عنوانِ بیمارِ بیمارستان
senses.en: The process of accepting a patient into a hospital for a stay and care.

senses.fa: پروندهٔ پزشکی؛ مجموعهٔ اطلاعاتِ سلامت و مراقبتِ فرد
senses.en: A recorded collection of information about a person’s health, assessments and care.

senses.fa: نسخهٔ دارویی؛ دستورِ مجازِ تهیهٔ دارو برای بیمار
senses.en: An order from an authorised prescriber for a patient’s medicine, recorded on paper or electronically.

senses.fa: غربالگری؛ بررسیِ افرادِ بی‌علامت برای احتمالِ نیاز به بررسیِ بیشتر
senses.en: An assessment offered to people without symptoms of the condition being checked, to identify those who may need further investigation.

senses.fa: تریاژ؛ ارزیابی و اولویت‌بندی بر پایهٔ فوریتِ نیازِ مراقبتی
senses.en: The assessment and prioritisation of patients according to the urgency of their care needs.

senses.fa: پیگیریِ درمانی؛ ارزیابیِ بعدی پس از مراجعه یا مراقبتِ قبلی
senses.en: A later consultation or assessment that reviews a patient after an earlier visit, investigation or treatment.
Internal force per unit area acting across a surface within a material.
A measure of deformation relative to an original length or shape.
Pulling action transmitted through a member that tends to lengthen it.
Pushing action that tends to shorten a member along the direction of loading.
Loading that tends to slide neighboring parts of a material past one another.
Deformation that curves the length of a member under transverse loading or applied moments.
Twisting deformation of a member about its longitudinal axis under torque.
Displacement of a point on a loaded member from its reference position.
Repeated mechanical motion back and forth about a reference or equilibrium position.
The number of complete oscillation cycles in a unit of time.
The greatest displacement from equilibrium in the oscillation being described.
An enhanced oscillatory response when periodic excitation is near a natural frequency of a system.
A soft semisolid medicine preparation made from an emulsion of oil and water.
A semisolid medicine preparation in which a gelling material gives a liquid its structured consistency.

senses.fa: چسبِ داروییِ پوستی برای جذبِ سراسری
senses.en: A medicine-containing adhesive patch designed to deliver its medicine through the skin into the bloodstream.
A liquid medicine for swallowing that contains fine solid particles dispersed in the liquid rather than fully dissolved.
A small sealed packet used to contain a pharmaceutical preparation.

senses.fa: اسپریِ بینی؛ فرآوردهٔ مایعِ پاششیِ بینی
senses.en: A liquid preparation designed to be delivered into the nose as a fine spray.
A sterile liquid preparation made for application to the eye in drops.
A needle-free measuring device with a barrel and plunger designed for liquid medicines given by mouth.
A tablet formulated to break down in water with the release of gas bubbles.
A small device with a blade and a holder designed to divide a medicine tablet.
A label added when a medicine is supplied, identifying the dispensed medicine and patient-specific directions.
A document supplied with a medicine that explains information patients need about that product and its use.
A thin spacer used to adjust a gap, fit or alignment between parts.

senses.fa: اورینگ؛ حلقهٔ آب‌بندی با مقطعِ گرد
senses.en: A sealing ring with a circular cross-section, usually made from an elastic polymer.
A split ring fitted in a piston groove to contact the cylinder wall.
A ring seated in a groove to keep a component from moving axially beyond it.
A support or casing that holds a bearing in its intended position.
A bearing designed primarily to support loads along the axis of a rotating shaft.
Forming a metal part by filling a mould with molten metal and allowing it to solidify.
Shaping solid metal by compressive forces applied with tools such as dies or hammers.

senses.fa: اکستروژن؛ شکل‌دهی با راندن از قالب
senses.en: Forming a continuous section by forcing material through a shaped die opening.
Shaping a part by injecting material into a closed mould cavity.
Reducing or shaping material by passing it between rotating rolls.
The outer epithelial layer of the skin, lying above the dermis.
The connective-tissue layer of the skin beneath the epidermis that supports vessels, nerves and skin structures.
The layer beneath the skin proper containing loose connective tissue and varying amounts of fat.
A moist tissue lining, with an epithelial surface and supporting connective tissue, in passages that open to the outside.
A gland that makes saliva and sends it into the mouth through a duct.

senses.fa: فولیکولِ مو؛ ساختارِ پیرامونِ ریشهٔ مو
senses.en: A tube-like skin structure that surrounds the hair root and supports hair growth.
A skin gland that produces sweat and releases it through a duct.
A skin gland that releases an oily secretion called sebum, usually into a hair follicle.
An endocrine gland in the front of the neck, with two main lobes beside the upper trachea, that releases thyroid hormones.
A small endocrine gland at the base of the brain, connected by a stalk to the hypothalamus.
One of a pair of endocrine glands above the kidneys, each with an outer cortex and an inner medulla.
A channel that carries lymph through the lymphatic system toward its return to the bloodstream.
A cylindrical pin used to locate mating parts relative to one another.
A screw used to secure a part by pressing its tip against another part.

senses.fa: پیچِ دوسررزوه؛ میلهٔ رزوه‌دارِ بدونِ سر
senses.en: A headless fastener with external threads at both ends or along its length.
A fork-shaped connector with aligned holes in two ears for a connecting pin.
An adjustable connector whose body engages end fittings with opposite-handed threads.
A threaded fastener with an eye-shaped head for connection to another component.
A split pin whose two legs pass through a hole and can be bent apart to retain a component.
A rolling bearing that uses balls between its raceways.
A rolling bearing that uses long, slender cylindrical rollers.
A toothed belt that meshes with toothed pulleys to transmit synchronized rotation.
A coupling that transmits rotation between shafts whose axes meet at an angle.
A gear device in which a screw-shaped worm meshes with a toothed wheel on a non-intersecting axis.
A doctor trained to treat conditions by performing operations.
A doctor who specializes in interpreting medical images and using imaging in patient care.
A health professional trained to support pregnancy, childbirth and care after birth.
An eye-care professional trained to assess vision and eye health and provide care within their scope of practice.
A health professional trained to assess nutritional needs and provide food and nutrition care.

senses.fa: متخصصِ ارائهٔ بیهوشی؛ فردِ حرفه‌ایِ بیهوشی
senses.en: A health professional trained to provide anaesthesia and monitor patients during procedures.
A health professional who helps people participate in everyday activities by adapting tasks, skills or environments.
A health professional who assesses hearing and related balance problems and provides care within their scope.
A professional who assesses and supports speech, language and communication, and may also work with swallowing difficulties.
A person trained to convey communication accurately between languages in a healthcare encounter.

senses.fa: مراقب؛ فردِ کمک‌کننده در مراقبتِ روزمره
senses.en: A person who provides practical care or support to someone who needs help with daily life.
A doctor who specializes in the health and medical care of babies, children and young people.
A masonry unit shaped to fit into the curved course of an arch or vault.
A rounded roof or ceiling structure that curves over an area.
An arched roof or ceiling structure spanning a space.
A structural member fixed at one end and projecting with the other end unsupported.
A foundation pile deliberately installed at an inclination to the vertical.
A roof member running lengthwise across the main roof frames to support the roof covering.
A structural member running diagonally between frame points to resist distortion of the frame.
A structural wall that resists lateral forces acting in its plane and transfers them toward the foundation.
A wire-mesh container filled with stone for use in earth-retaining or erosion-control works.
A small drainage opening that lets trapped or seeping water escape from behind or within a structure.
A temporary enclosure that holds back water so construction can take place in a relatively dry area.
A large box or cylinder sunk into the ground or a waterbed to form part of a foundation.
One of the two external openings through which air enters or leaves the nose.
The central wall of cartilage and bone that separates the left and right nasal cavities.
The small soft projection that hangs from the middle of the back edge of the soft palate.
The roof of the mouth, with a firm front part and a flexible back part.
A leaf-shaped piece of elastic cartilage behind the tongue that helps protect the entrance to the larynx during swallowing.
The muscular passage behind the nose and mouth that leads toward the larynx and oesophagus.
One of the larger branching airways that carries air from the trachea into and within a lung.
A small airway within a lung that branches from the bronchi and leads toward the gas-exchanging region.
One of the tiny thin-walled air spaces in a lung where gases pass between air and nearby blood.
A thin two-layered membrane that covers a lung and lines the inside of its surrounding chest space.

senses.fa: سینوسِ کنارِ بینی؛ حفرهٔ هواییِ پارانازال
senses.en: An air-filled cavity in a skull bone near the nose that communicates with the nasal cavity.
One of a pair of tissue folds in the larynx whose vibration produces the sound of the voice.

senses.fa: ریلِ دین؛ ریلِ نصبِ تجهیزاتِ برقی
senses.en: A standardized metal mounting rail used to support electrical components in an enclosure.
A tray-like support system that carries and routes cables.

senses.fa: گلندِ کابل؛ بستِ آب‌بندِ ورودیِ کابل
senses.en: A fitting that secures a cable where it enters an enclosure and can seal around its outer jacket.
A terminal fitted to a cable conductor so it can connect to a stud, bolt or other terminal.
A component that holds a fuse and connects its contacts into a circuit.
An electrically operated switch used to make or break a power circuit.
A switch actuator operated by pressing a button.
A switch operated by moving a small lever between positions.
An assembly that distributes an electrical supply to outgoing circuits and houses their switching or protective devices.

senses.fa: میلهٔ زمین؛ الکترودِ میله‌ایِ اتصالِ زمین
senses.en: A conductive rod placed in the ground as an electrode for an earthing system.

senses.fa: وسیلهٔ حفاظتِ جریانِ باقیمانده؛ کلیدِ محافظِ جریانِ نشتی
senses.en: A protective device that disconnects a circuit when the detected imbalance between its monitored currents exceeds a specified level.
An electrical connector attached to a conductor by compressing a metal contact around it.
An instrument with light and optics for examining the inside of the eye, especially its back surface.
A small pen-shaped flashlight used to provide light during an examination.
A two-pronged metal instrument that produces a particular tone and vibration when made to vibrate.
A display of letters or symbols in different sizes used to assess how clearly a person can see.
A medical instrument with illumination and a viewing system for looking inside a body cavity or organ.
An instrument that provides a view of the larynx and its entrance.
A conductive contact that links the body to equipment for recording signals or delivering electrical current.
A device that can deliver a controlled electrical shock to treat certain dangerous heart rhythms.

senses.fa: کانولای وریدی؛ لولهٔ دسترسی به ورید
senses.en: A small tube placed in a vein to provide intravenous access.
A tube placed in the body to drain fluid or provide a route to an internal space.

senses.fa: کلاهِ جراحی؛ پوششِ موی اتاقِ عمل
senses.en: A head covering worn in a surgical setting to contain hair.
A loose garment worn by a patient during a medical examination or hospital care.
A pipe fitting that joins pipe sections of different diameters.
A detachable pipe fitting whose nut draws two end pieces together.
A rotating drum used to store and pay out a hose.
A transparent viewing part that allows fluid inside equipment or pipework to be observed.
A closed container designed to hold a fluid at a pressure different from the surrounding pressure.
A flow passage that narrows to a throat and then gradually widens.
A plate with a defined opening placed across a flow passage to produce a restriction.
A device that retains solid particles from a fluid using a screen.
A valve that adjusts a small flow passage by moving a tapered stem tip relative to a seat.
A valve that controls flow by moving a flexible diaphragm toward or away from a seating surface.
A flexible corrugated component that can change shape to accommodate movement.

senses.fa: دمپرِ هوا؛ دریچهٔ تنظیمِ جریانِ هوا
senses.en: A movable plate or set of blades that adjusts airflow through a duct.
A crack or break in a bone.
An injury in which a ligament at a joint is stretched too far or torn.
An injury in which the ends of bones at a joint move out of their normal positions.
A superficial skin wound caused by rubbing or scraping away part of the surface.
An open cut or tear in the skin, often with irregular edges.
An injury to skin or other tissue caused by heat, chemicals, electricity or radiation.

senses.fa: سوختگی با مایعِ داغ یا بخار
senses.en: A burn caused by hot liquid or steam.
A shortage of fluid in the body that develops when fluid loss exceeds fluid intake.
A condition in which the concentration of haemoglobin in the blood is lower than expected.
Yellowing of the skin or whites of the eyes associated with a build-up of bilirubin.

senses.fa: سیانوز؛ رنگ‌گرفتگیِ آبی یا خاکستریِ پوست یا مخاط
senses.en: A bluish or greyish colour of skin or mucous membranes associated with insufficient oxygenation of blood or reduced circulation.
Unusual paleness or loss of colour in skin or mucous membranes compared with a person's usual appearance.
A flat sloping face that replaces a sharp edge between two surfaces.
A rounded transition where two surfaces meet at an inside corner.
A narrow recessed channel in the surface of a part.
An elongated narrow opening or recess in a part.
A small cut or indentation that opens from the edge of a part.
A helical ridge on a cylindrical or conical surface that can engage a matching thread.
A conical recess at the opening of a hole, often used to receive a matching screw head.
A cylindrical flat-bottomed enlargement at the opening of a smaller hole.
A hole that ends within a part instead of passing all the way through it.
A hole that passes completely through a part and opens on both sides.
A gradual decrease in the width or diameter of a part along its length.
A lengthwise ridge on a shaft that engages a matching groove in a hub to transmit rotation.
The tough white outer wall of the eyeball, continuous with the clear cornea at the front.
A thin membrane lining the inside of the eyelids and covering the front of the sclera, but not the cornea.
The transparent structure behind the iris that changes shape to help focus light on the retina.
The bundle of nerve fibres that carries visual signals from the retina toward the brain.
The area of the retina where nerve fibres gather and leave the eye as the optic nerve.
The central region of the retina used for detailed central vision, with the fovea at its centre.
The small central depression in the macula where the eye has its sharpest detailed vision.
The transparent gel that fills the large space behind the lens and in front of the retina.
The clear watery fluid in the anterior and posterior chambers in front of the lens.
The gland in the upper outer part of the orbit that supplies much of the watery part of tears.
A drainage passage that carries tears from the lacrimal sac beside the inner corner of the eye into the nose.
The ring of smooth muscle in the ciliary body that alters tension in the lens-supporting fibres to change lens shape.
A semiconductor device that converts light directly into electrical energy.
A device that absorbs solar energy to heat a fluid.
The housing at the top of a wind-turbine tower that encloses major generating equipment.
An aerodynamic arm of a wind-turbine rotor that captures energy from moving air.
The rotating part of an electric motor or generator.
The stationary part of an electric motor or generator that works with the rotor.
A generator that converts mechanical rotation into alternating electrical current.
An enclosed assembly of gears that transmits rotation between shafts.
A device that connects or disconnects rotating drive parts by engaging or separating friction surfaces.
A brake that slows rotation by pressing friction pads against the sides of a rotating disc.
A replaceable friction block on a backing plate that presses against a brake disc.
A rotating shaft that transmits torque between separated parts of a vehicle’s drivetrain.

senses.fa: شستنِ دست‌ها با آب و صابون
senses.en: Cleaning the hands with soap and water.

senses.fa: محلول یا ژلِ الکلیِ بهداشتِ دست
senses.en: An alcohol-based liquid or gel rubbed onto the hands to reduce microorganisms.
A chemical preparation used to inactivate harmful microorganisms on non-living surfaces or objects.

senses.fa: اتوکلاو؛ دستگاهِ استریل‌سازی با بخارِ تحتِ فشار
senses.en: A pressure-chamber device that uses steam to sterilize suitable equipment.
A sealable package designed to admit a sterilizing agent and protect its contents during processing and later storage.
A sheet used to cover the patient or nearby surfaces and define a protected area for a surgical procedure.
A transparent visor worn in front of the face as a barrier against splashes.
A protective covering worn over a shoe in a clinical setting.
An area prepared and maintained with sterile barriers and supplies for a procedure, with contamination excluded.
A long-sleeved protective garment worn over clothing as a barrier during patient care.
A single-use sleeveless covering worn over the front of clothing for protection during care tasks.
A container designated for non-sharp waste from clinical care.
A gear with teeth on a conical surface, used to transmit rotation between intersecting shafts.
A cylindrical gear whose teeth run obliquely across its width.
A threaded screw that works with a sliding nut to convert rotation into straight-line motion.
A screw-and-nut mechanism that converts rotation into linear motion through recirculating balls.
An assembly that supports and constrains a moving part to travel along a straight path.
A bearing that supports a part while allowing straight-line motion along a shaft or rail.
A mechanism whose toothed wheel and catch allow movement in one direction while resisting movement back.
A pivoting catch that engages the teeth of a ratchet wheel to drive it or prevent reverse motion.
A circular disc fixed to a shaft with its centre offset from the shaft’s axis.
A rolling-element bearing that uses rollers rather than balls between its rings.
A shaft connection that transmits torque while accommodating limited relative displacement between the shafts.
A device that takes up slack and maintains tension in a chain drive.
One of the two tubes that carry urine from the kidneys to the bladder.
The tube that carries urine from the bladder to an opening outside the body.
The funnel-shaped collecting space in a kidney where urine from the calyces enters the ureter.
A microscopic functional unit of a kidney, consisting of a renal corpuscle and a tubule that processes the filtered fluid.
A tuft of tiny blood vessels inside a renal corpuscle where fluid is filtered from the blood.
The outer functional region of a kidney, beneath its capsule, containing renal corpuscles and parts of the renal tubules.
The inner region of a kidney, arranged in pyramids containing straight tubular structures and blood vessels.
The tube of a nephron that receives filtered fluid and changes its composition by exchanging substances with the surrounding tissues and blood.
The thin fibrous covering directly around the outer surface of a kidney.
The cup-shaped part of a nephron surrounding the glomerulus and receiving the fluid filtered from its blood vessels.
An artery that supplies blood to a kidney, usually branching from the abdominal aorta.
A vein that carries blood away from a kidney toward the inferior vena cava.
An instrument that measures how far a surface lies below a reference surface.
An instrument with a vertically moving measuring arm that measures or marks height above a reference plane.
An instrument that checks the internal size of a bore using contacts against its walls.
A tool with toothed leaves that compares the pitch and profile of a screw thread.
A tool with curved reference edges for comparing the radius of a rounded corner or surface.
A precision cylindrical pin of a known diameter used as a reference for checking holes or gaps.
A fixed-size gauge inserted into a hole to check its internal size, often with separate limit ends.
A precision ring with a fixed internal diameter used to check an external diameter or provide a reference size.
A precision bar supported by two equal rollers at a known centre distance, used with a height difference to set or check an angle.
A support block with a V-shaped groove that locates a workpiece against two angled faces.
A layout and measuring tool with a sliding rule and a head that provides square and mitre reference faces.
A water-resistant chair designed for a person to sit on while showering.
A strong fixed bar that a person can hold for support when moving or changing position.
An added toilet seat that increases the height of the sitting surface above the toilet bowl.
A belt worn around a person's waist that gives a helper a place to hold during an assisted transfer or movement.
A ball used as equipment in therapy or rehabilitation exercises, often a large inflatable ball.
A compact stationary device with rotating pedals for exercising the legs or, on suitable models, the arms.
A weighted cuff that fastens around the ankle to add resistance during selected exercises.

senses.fa: وسیلهٔ تمرینِ گرفتنِ دست؛ فنرِ تقویتِ پنجه
senses.en: A small device squeezed with the hand against resistance to exercise the grip.
A mouldable material that offers resistance when squeezed, stretched or pinched in hand therapy.
A support fitted to a finger to hold it in a selected position or limit particular movements.
A firm foam cylinder used as a support or rolling surface in exercise and physical therapy.
A portable padded covering placed on the floor to provide a surface for exercise.
A machining process in which a rotating drill advances into material to make a hole.
A machining process that removes material with a rotating cutter whose cutting edges pass through the work in succession.
A machining process in which a cutting tool removes material from a rotating workpiece.
A machining process that enlarges or improves an existing hole by cutting its internal surface.
A hole-finishing process that removes a small amount of material with a multi-edge cutting tool.
The production of a helical screw thread on an external or internal surface.
A machining process that removes material with abrasive grains held in a moving tool such as a grinding wheel.
A finishing process that reduces fine surface irregularities to make a surface smoother or more lustrous.
A finishing process in which abrasive stones move against a surface to refine its geometry and texture, commonly inside a bore.
A fine finishing process that uses abrasive particles between a workpiece and a supporting tool called a lap.
A machining process that forms a profile with successive cutting teeth on a tool called a broach.
A collection bag connected to urinary drainage tubing to receive urine from the body.
A bag designed to collect vomit, often with a firm wide rim around its opening.
A closable container, commonly made of flexible rubber, that holds hot water as a source of warmth.
A sealed pack used as a source of cooling, such as a flexible pouch containing chilled gel.

senses.fa: پمپِ انفوزیون؛ پمپِ رساندنِ کنترل‌شدهٔ مایع
senses.en: An external medical pump that delivers liquid to a patient in a controlled way.
A pump that holds a syringe and moves its plunger mechanically to control the delivery of liquid.
An electronic device that receives measurements from sensors and displays information about a patient's bodily functions.

senses.fa: کیسه‌ـ‌دریچه‌ـ‌ماسک؛ وسیلهٔ دستیِ کمک به تنفس
senses.en: A hand-operated breathing device with a compressible bag, valves and a face mask that can deliver air or oxygen-enriched gas.
A strong container that stores oxygen gas under pressure for use through suitable delivery equipment.
A machine that takes in surrounding air and separates out some other gases to supply gas with a higher oxygen concentration.
A medical device that creates suction through tubing to draw secretions or other fluids into a collection container.
Pliers designed to remove insulation from a wire while leaving its conductor intact.
A chemical preparation that helps remove surface oxides and promotes wetting by molten solder.
A tool that draws molten solder away from a joint by suction.
A fine copper braid that absorbs molten solder by capillary action.
A small metal sleeve crimped around the stripped end of a stranded wire to hold its strands together.
A connector that holds an integrated circuit and makes electrical contact with its terminals without soldering the chip directly to the board.
A connector that makes contact with conductive pads along the edge of a circuit board.
A flat cable whose insulated conductors run beside one another in a parallel strip.
A cable with a central conductor and a surrounding conductive shield separated by an insulating dielectric.
Two separately insulated conductors twisted around one another as a pair.
A tool that joins or terminates parts by compressing a metal sleeve or terminal around a conductor.
The blind-ended pouch at the beginning of the large intestine, where the ileum joins it.
A narrow blind-ended tube attached to the caecum.
The part of the large intestine between the caecum and rectum, comprising ascending, transverse, descending and sigmoid sections.
The final portion of the large intestine between the sigmoid colon and the anal canal, where stool can be stored before passing out.
The first part of the small intestine, extending from the stomach to the jejunum.
The middle part of the small intestine, between the duodenum and ileum.
The final part of the small intestine, continuing from the jejunum to the caecum.
The thin serous membrane that lines the abdominal cavity and covers many abdominal organs.
A double fold of peritoneum that attaches the jejunum and ileum to the back wall of the abdomen and carries their vessels, nerves and lymphatics.
The duct formed where the common hepatic duct meets the cystic duct, carrying bile toward the duodenum.
The large vein that carries blood from much of the digestive tract and from organs such as the spleen toward the liver.

senses.fa: دریچهٔ ایلئوسکال؛ دریچهٔ بینِ ایلئوم و سکوم
senses.en: The valve-like folds at the opening where the ileum enters the caecum.
A stationary passage or set of passages that slows fluid leaving a pump impeller and helps recover static pressure.
A valve whose disc or plug moves toward or away from a fixed seat to stop or regulate flow.
A valve that controls flow by rotating a cylindrical or tapered plug with a passage through it.

senses.fa: پمپِ گریز از مرکز؛ پمپِ سانتریفیوژ
senses.en: A pump in which a rotating impeller transfers energy to liquid and sends it toward a surrounding outlet passage.
A positive-displacement pump that moves liquid in spaces between gear teeth and a close-fitting casing.
A positive-displacement pump that moves liquid by repeatedly flexing a diaphragm to change a chamber's volume.

senses.fa: شیرِ اطمینانِ فشار؛ شیرِ رهاییِ فشار
senses.en: A valve that opens when pressure exceeds a set level to release fluid and limit excessive pressure.

senses.fa: شیرِ پایی؛ شیرِ یک‌طرفهٔ انتهای مکش
senses.en: A check valve at a pump suction inlet, commonly combined with a strainer, that helps prevent liquid from draining back.

senses.fa: تهویه؛ تبادلِ هوای داخل و بیرون
senses.en: The exchange of air in an enclosed space with air from outside it.
A fluid property describing its resistance to relative motion between neighbouring layers, often noticed as resistance to flowing.

senses.fa: کاویتاسیون؛ تشکیل و فروپاشیِ حباب‌های بخار در مایع
senses.en: The formation of vapour-filled cavities in a low-pressure region of liquid and their collapse when the pressure rises again.
The part of a clinical examination in which a clinician carefully looks at the body or a body region.
